name: Isabel Wiseler-Lima - § 24 - Am 79
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 24. Is deeply concerned by growing attacks against the rules-based global order by authoritarian and totalitarian regimes, including through unprovoked and unjustified aggression against peaceful neighbours and through the undermining of the functioning of UN bodies, namely the abuse of veto power at the UN Security Council; underlines that the UN Human Rights Council (UNHRC) and the UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees (UNRWA) require greater scrutiny, as the UNHRC has enabled human rights abusers to shield themselves from accountability, rather than fulfilling its mandate to protect fundamental freedoms; stresses the need for a thorough evaluation of whether these bodies are effectively serving their intended purposes; emphasises that the diminishing effectiveness of these bodies has severe consequences, including escalating conflicts, loss of life and widespread human suffering, while also seriously weakening the global community’s ability to address pressing global challenges; calls on the Member States and like minded partners to develop a robust strategy and to intensify their efforts to reverse this trend and to send a united and strong message of support to those organisations when they are unjustly attacked or threatened; believes that the UN, its bodies, and other multilateral organisations are in need of reform, in order to address these growing challenges and threats;
